toolkit_connection_statuses.description: HubSpot is an inbound marketing, sales, and customer service platform integrating CRM, email automation, and analytics to facilitate lead nurturing and seamless customer experiences
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=hubspot. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="hubspot") to create a connection BEFORE executing any hubspot tools.

HUBSPOT_UPDATE_QUOTE.description: Performs a partial update on an existing HubSpot quote's specified properties, identifying the quote by `quoteId` (either its internal ID or a custom unique property value if `idProperty` is provided).

quoteId.description: Unique identifier of the quote. Typically an internal HubSpot object ID, or a unique property value if `idProperty` is specified.

idProperty.description: Optional. Name of a unique quote property. If provided, `quoteId` is interpreted as this property's value, not the internal object ID.

properties.description: Properties to update on the quote (internal property names to new values). Only included properties will be updated.

HUBSPOT_BATCH_UPDATE_QUOTES.description: Updates multiple existing HubSpot quotes in a batch; each quote is identified by its object ID or a custom unique property (via `idProperty`), and only writable properties are modified.

id.description: The quote's HubSpot object ID or the value of the unique property specified by `idProperty`.

idProperty.description: Name of the unique property used for quote identification if `id` is not the HubSpot object ID. If omitted, `id` is assumed to be the object ID.

properties.description: Dictionary of writable properties to update (e.g., `hs_title`, `hs_status`). Keys are internal property names; values are the new property values.

items.description: Defines a single quote update, specifying its identifier and the properties to change.

inputs.description: List of `InputsRequest` objects, each specifying a quote to update and its new property values.

HUBSPOT_GET_QUOTE.description: Retrieves a specific HubSpot quote by its unique identifier.

quoteId.description: Unique identifier of the quote; can be the HubSpot object ID or a custom unique property value if `idProperty` is specified.

archived.description: Specifies whether the quote to retrieve is archived (`True`) or active (`False`).

idProperty.description: Internal name of a unique custom property to use as the quote identifier instead of the HubSpot object ID; this property must have unique values across all quotes.

properties.description: HubSpot property internal names to include in the response; limits data returned and improves performance. Non-existent properties are ignored.

associations.description: Object type names (e.g., 'deals', 'contacts') for which to retrieve IDs of associated objects; fetches linked CRM object IDs. Non-existent association types are ignored.

propertiesWithHistory.description: HubSpot property internal names for which to include historical values; retrieves change history. Non-existent properties or those without history are ignored.

HUBSPOT_SEARCH_QUOTES_BY_CRITERIA.description: Searches HubSpot CRM quotes using a text query, complex filter criteria, sorting, and pagination.
